products.name: Keyar DT Lite®
products.description: The Keyar DT Lite connects wirelessly to a mobile app, enabling recording of fetal heartbeats, conducting Non Stress Tests (NST), and sharing real-time reports with doctors and specialists.
products.theImpact: Enables early detection and continuous monitoring of high-risk pregnancies through frontline care—reducing delays in care and minimizing frequent hospital visits.
features: Record results and access past reports

products.name: JPD-100E
products.description: The device uses a 2.5 MHz ultrasound transducer to detect fetal heart rate. Results are shown in real time on its LCD screen, with heartbeat values, waveforms and audio output.
products.theImpact: Empowering health care workers to detect any abnormal fetal heart patterns early, and provide timely reassurance and guidance to mothers to act promptly to ensure safer outcomes.
features: Detects fetal heartbeat clearly from the 16th week of pregnancy.
Lightweight and portable for home or clinical use.

products.name: MOMI®
products.description: Lightweight titanium ring that continuously monitors essential vital signs. Connects to the Janitri app and provides insights for expectant and new mothers.
products.theImpact: Supports healthier pregnancies & smoother postpartum recovery - transforming maternal care with continuous data and early alerts.
features: Dedicated modes for pregnancy, postpartum and daily health.
Tracks Heart rate, Heart rate variability, SpO2, body temperature, sleep quality, stress levels, nutrition, and activity.
Extended battery life of 7+ days with water resistance up to 50m.

products.name: Bempu Tempwatch & BellyButton
products.description:
Tempwatch tracks the body temperature — blue when warm and orange with alert when cold.

BellyButton tracks abdominal breathing — green when normal, and red with alert and vibration to stimulate the baby when movement slow or stops.
products.theImpact: Up to 40% of neonatal deaths and complications from hypothermia can be prevented with early detection.
features: Easy to use in home or clinics
Instant alerts through sound, light and notifications on phones/tablets.
Safe and comfortable radiation-free design. Rechargable.
Proven use for 60,000 babies in 14 countries

products.name: echOpen O1
products.description: The echOpen O1 operates across three frequencies in a single probe, enabling quick visualization of major organs such as the heart, lungs, and kidneys in 5 minutes. Connects to a mobile application that displays real-time images.
products.theImpact:
Almost 50% of diagnosis are modified after a POCUS examination.
13% decrease in patients referral to secondary care.
features: Validated image quality through clinical studies.
Easy-to-use interface for diverse medical specialties.
Single battery charge allows multiple examinations throughout the day.
Continuous updates through a digital platform.
Enables remote access and collaborative learning.

products.name: LVOCheck
products.description: LVOCheck combines stroke-specific biomarkers with AI analysis to deliver an accurate diagnosis in under 10 minutes. Usable in ambulances, health centres, or by community healthcare workers.
products.theImpact:
Helps prevent long-term disability, addressing the cause of 95% of stroke-related disabilities.
Enables frontline healthcare workers to act early and guide patients to the right care.
features: Accurately identifies Large Vessel Occlusion (LVO) strokes caused by major brain artery blockage.
Also identifies other stroke types or heart attacks.
Simple to use for pre-hospital triage, no specialist expertise required.

products.name: MEDSINC
products.description: The platform uses machine learning to analyze clinical data entered by healthcare workers to determine illness severity, provides diagnostic insights, and recommends treatment or referrals.
products.theImpact:
Enables community and frontline health workers to assess over 300 clinical risks.
Facilitated over 2.1 million clinical encounters across 5 countries, helping close the healthcare gap for underserved communities.
features: Clinically validated with accuracy of up to 95%
Improves adherence to medical protocols by ~ 40%
Reduces supervision and training costs by ~ 50%
Works offline and supports over 15 languages
Generates real-time data for population health monitoring and disease surveillance

products.name: BabyBeat Monitor
products.description: Advanced continuous monitoring system for tracking fetal heart rate and maternal contractions during labor and delivery.
products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with continuous fetal monitor technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.name: PregnaCare Plus
products.description: Comprehensive maternal health monitoring system tracking blood pressure, glucose levels, and vital signs throughout pregnancy.
products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with maternal health tracker technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.name: Navam SpO₂
products.description: Lightweight sensor is attached to the baby’s foot, where it continuously measures oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and heart rate which is transmitted to a mobile app.
products.theImpact: Empowers caregivers at the community level to improve neonatal outcomes by enabling timely interventions, reducing preventable complications.
features: Enables early detection of abnormalities in oxygen levels or heart rate.
Lightweight, soft and breathable material ensures long-wear comfort for babies.

products.name: IMPALA system
products.description: The IMPALA System delivers real-time patient monitoring and decision support. The monitor tracks vital signs, while the app and server connect healthcare workers to patient data, alerts and trend analysis.
products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with phototherapy device technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.
features: Implemented in hospitals in Malawi, Tanzania, and Rwanda.

products.name: BabyGuard Monitor

products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with vital signs monitor technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.name: TinyWarmer Incubator
products.description: Portable transport incubator maintaining optimal temperature and humidity for safe neonatal transfer between facilities.
products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with transport incubator technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.name: Ostium
products.description: Health workers use the portable digital stethoscope to record a patient’s breath sounds in six positions in less than 5 minutes. The AI model analyzes the sound patterns in real time to detect signs of pulmonary TB.
products.theImpact:
63% reduction in missed TB-positive cases.
2.7x more effective than symptomatic screening
Built and validated on over 30,000 lung recordings.
features: Portable and easy to use anywhere without specialist operators.
Guided device placement to ensure proper recording.
Cost-effective at < $2 per screening, meeting WHO’s TB cost guideline.

products.name: Omron COMPLETE
products.description: With a simple cuff wrap and one-touch operation, the device measures blood pressure and ECG . It syncs with the OMRON Connect app, allowing users to track results, view trends, and share health data for timely intervention.
products.theImpact: Empowers front line health care workers to detect cardiac issues early and take preventive actions that improve heart health and saves lives.
features: Clinically validated accuracy with Intellisense technology
Identifies Atrial Fibrillation, Bradycardia, Tachycardia and Sinus rhythms
Portable, user-friendly design for non specialist user with clear display and memory for 90 readings

products.name: GlucoseGuard Monitor

products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with glucose monitoring system technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.theImpact: Empowers frontline healthcare workers with ecg screening device technology to improve patient outcomes and deliver better care at the point of need.

products.name: EDKD®
products.description: Test kit is used to collect a sample and upload an image via the app. The image is analysed to generate a Kidney Health Score, identifying renal abnormalities at their earliest stages.
products.theImpact: Empowers front line healthcare workers to detect  kidney disease in its silent stages- improving treatment outcomes, reducing reliance on invasive interventions, and easing facility burden by remote monitoring.
features: Cost-effective alternative to frequent lab testing for monitoring.
Provides real-time, transparent health data for informed decisions.
Early detection enables lifestyle or therapeutic interventions to slow Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) progression.

products.name: Trister Multi-Check
products.description: Measures blood glucose, cholesterol and uric acid. Uses auto strip recognition technology to identify the test type and deliver accurate results on a LCD display.
products.theImpact: Reduces the need for multiple devices and frequent lab tests by making chronic disease screening & monitoring simpler and more accessible.
features: Accurate readings with minimal blood sample.
Convenient for remote or clinical use.
Easy-to-read large LCD screen with low battery indicator.

products.name: MalariaDetect Kit

features: FDA cleared, offers higher reporting accuracy through rigorous quality control.

Zero setup cost and seamless integration with existing systems

products.name: HealthPulse
products.description: HealthPulse uses AI to analyze images of rapid diagnostic tests captured through smartphones. It interprets test lines, verifies image quality and automatically reports results.
products.theImpact:
Being deployed across multiple African countries, including Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, South Africa, Benin, and Côte d’Ivoire. 
The platform strengthens diagnostic accuracy and data reporting for diseases like malaria, HIV, and COVID-19.
features: Achieves 90–95% accuracy using AI-powered interpretation of test results.
Works on standard smartphones and integrates into EMR or public health systems.
Enables real-time disease surveillance and program monitoring.
Scalable and cost-effective for low-resource and remote healthcare settings.
